"""Main owns source application, CPU-only build and real expert kernel measurements."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, re, time, traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
BASE=G/'.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
W=G/'.worktree/diag-cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012'
T=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
L=T.parent.parent.parent/'.lint'
GGML=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cpu_measurement_owner',O)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV=dict(PATH=str(T/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(T/'lib'),OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')
def ident(p): return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-cpu-job-and-raw-benchmark-qualification-root-v1'
 assert not out.exists(); out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=ident(Path(__file__)),boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),source_changes=[],binaries={},measurements={})
 def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save); r['commands']=owner.commands
 started=time.monotonic()
 def run(label,argv,cwd=W,wall=180,env=ENV,expected=0):
  left=1000-(time.monotonic()-started); assert left>0
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,argv,env,cwd,wall=min(wall,left),cpu=900,rss_cap=20<<30,text_cap=8<<20,total_cap=128<<20,file_cap=128<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text()); save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==expected
  return so.read_text(),se.read_text()
 try:
  assert not run('base-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],BASE)[0].strip()
  assert run('base-head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'],BASE)[0].strip()=='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035'
  assert run('ggml-head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'],GGML)[0].strip()=='3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d'
  assert not run('ggml-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],GGML)[0].strip()
  assert m.sha(T/'bin/clang++')=='1290881b4e12a5e002e5b0de0787f85328ee5fe19f253a54be1cdd97dc2f26eb'
  assert not W.exists()
  run('worktree',['/usr/bin/git','worktree','add','-b','diag/cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012',str(W),'0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035'],BASE)
  listing=run('worktrees',['/usr/bin/git','worktree','list','--porcelain'],W)[0]
  assert 'worktree '+str(W)+'\n' in listing
  r['compiler']=ident(T/'bin/clang++')
  for folder,pin in [('implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-source-v1','caeffc4d1faa4adc2e13ae6c14eddc08af06edc34e82e9999a269404c1d8aa13'),('implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-fixture-source-v1','d01f71ea9a0b2f42317532935878caed2d8d9a64232e50146e9adf4739551065'),('implementation-iq-avx2-raw-samples-source-v1',None)]:
   packet=B/folder; mp=packet/'manifest.json'
   if pin: assert m.sha(mp)==pin
   v=json.loads(mp.read_text())
   items=v.get('source_files')
   if items is None:
    assert folder == 'implementation-iq-avx2-raw-samples-source-v1'
    dest=W/'src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2_parity.cpp'
    source=Path(v['modified']['path'])
    assert m.sha(dest)==v['original']['sha256'] and m.sha(source)==v['modified']['sha256']
    dest.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    r['source_changes'].append(dict(packet=ident(mp),path='src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2_parity.cpp',before_sha256=v['original']['sha256'],after_sha256=v['modified']['sha256']))
    save(); continue
   for name,meta in items.items():
    dest=W/name; before=meta.get('before_sha256'); after=meta['after_sha256']
    if before: assert dest.exists() and m.sha(dest)==before
    else: assert not dest.exists()
    source=packet/'after'/name
    assert m.sha(source)==after
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    r['source_changes'].append(dict(packet=ident(mp),path=name,before_sha256=before,after_sha256=after))
   save()
  # The raw-sample signature follows the surrounding hand-written wrapping.
  raw=W/'src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2_parity.cpp'
  s=raw.read_text(); old='int bench(const std::vector<std::string>& pairs, const std::vector<int>& nts, int mb, int reps, bool dispatch_only, bool raw_samples) {'
  assert s.count(old)==1
  raw.write_text(s.replace(old,'int bench(const std::vector<std::string>& pairs, const std::vector<int>& nts, int mb, int reps,\n          bool dispatch_only, bool raw_samples) {'))
  # CPU sources and new fixture receive the same required project warnings/host sanitizer policy.
  cm=W/'CMakeLists.txt'; s=cm.read_text()
  assert s.count('target_link_libraries(strata_kernels_cpu PUBLIC Threads::Threads)')==1
  s=s.replace('target_link_libraries(strata_kernels_cpu PUBLIC Threads::Threads)','target_link_libraries(strata_kernels_cpu PUBLIC Threads::Threads PRIVATE strata_warnings)')
  s=s.replace('target_link_libraries(cpu_job_histogram_test PRIVATE strata_kernels_cpu)','target_link_libraries(cpu_job_histogram_test PRIVATE strata_kernels_cpu strata_warnings)')
  cm.write_text(s)
  r['main_adjustments']=[dict(path=str(raw),sha256=m.sha(raw),reason='Wrap new signature to existing source style'),dict(path=str(cm),sha256=m.sha(cm),reason='Apply project warnings and host sanitizer instrumentation to actual CPU math/pool and fixture')]
  (W/'LOCAL.md').write_text((BASE/'LOCAL.md').read_text())
  (W/'.lint').symlink_to(Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint'))
  run('diff-check',['/usr/bin/git','diff','--check'])
  targets=['cpu_job_histogram_test','iq_avx2_parity','q8k_quant_parity','q2_bitplane_parity','pool_tasks_test','pool_stress']
  for mode,license in [('free','free'),('contrib-llvm','contrib')]:
   build=W/'build'/('cpu-'+mode)
   run('configure-'+mode,['/usr/bin/cmake','-S',str(W),'-B',str(build),'-G','Ninja','-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release','-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER='+str(T/'bin/clang++'),'-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER='+str(T/'bin/clang'),'-DSTRATA_LICENSE='+license,'-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=OFF','-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=','-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=','-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=OFF','-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF','-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON','-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON','-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR='+str(GGML),'-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON'])
   run('build-'+mode,['/usr/bin/cmake','--build',str(build),'--parallel','4','--target',*targets],wall=300)
   for target in targets:
    p=build/target; r['binaries'][mode+'/'+target]=ident(p)
    text=run('needed-'+mode+'-'+target,['/usr/bin/readelf','-d',str(p)])[0]
    assert not re.search(r'NEEDED.*(sycl|ur_|ze_|cuda|hip|OpenCL|mkl)',text,re.I)
   save()
   run('ctest-'+mode,['/usr/bin/ctest','--test-dir',str(build),'--output-on-failure','-R','^(cpu_job_histogram_(off|on)|iq_avx2_parity|q8k_quant_parity|q2_bitplane_parity|pool_tasks_test|pool_stress)$'],wall=300)
  # Current mixed pack IQ3_S / IQ4_NL: phase-separated prequantized kernels, five raw samples per method/NT.
  text,err=run('bench-iq3s-iq4nl',['/usr/bin/taskset','-c','0',str(W/'build/cpu-free/iq_avx2_parity'),'--bench','--cpu','0','--nt','1,8','--mb','256','--reps','5','--pairs','iq3_s/iq4_nl','--dispatch','--raw-samples'],wall=180)
  samples=[]
  for line in text.splitlines():
   if line.startswith('SAMPLE '): samples.append(dict(word.split('=',1) for word in line.split()[1:]))
  assert len(samples)==30
  for nt in ('1','8'):
   for method in ('kernels','ggml','engine'):
    rows=[x for x in samples if x['nt']==nt and x['method']==method]
    assert len(rows)==5 and {x['rep'] for x in rows}==set(map(str,range(5)))
  r['measurements']['iq3_s/iq4_nl']=dict(samples=samples,scope='One pinned thread, prequantized GU and independent Down activations,256MiB synthetic valid native experts; excludes pool dispatch, activation quantization, GPU, DMA and model quality',command_label='bench-iq3s-iq4nl')
  assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()==r['boot_id']
  r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as e:
  r['error']=repr(e); r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:
  r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','complete')}))
 raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
